goal_name: 6. Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all
target_name: 6.a By 2030, expand international cooperation and capacity-building support to developing countries in water- and sanitation-related activities and programmes, including water harvesting, desalination, water efficiency, wastewater treatment, recycling and reuse technologies
indicator_name1: 6.a.1.1 Amount of water- and sanitation-related official development assistance that is part of a government-coordinated spending plan, based on national data
organization_name: Ministry of Finance of the Kyrgyz Republic (International Cooperation Department)
definitions: The amount of official development assistance provided to the Kyrgyz Republic in the form of investment loans and grants to finance water supply and sanitation projects and programmes included in a government-coordinated spending plan.
concepts:
Official development assistance (ODA) consists of grants and concessional loans provided by international and bilateral donors to promote sustainable development.

A public investment project is a set of activities with clearly defined objectives and results, implemented within a fixed schedule and organizational structure. Under the Regulation on Public Investment Management, approved by Government Resolution No. 232 of 28 May 2019, public investment projects are financed from the republican budget, including external borrowing and grants under international agreements of the Kyrgyz Republic.
rationale_interpretation: The indicator measures the level of international financial support provided to the Kyrgyz Republic for water supply and sanitation through grants and investment loans.
data_collection: Under paragraph 90 of the Regulation on Public Investment Management, approved by Government Resolution No. 232 of 28 May 2019, the implementing agency submits monthly financial reports to the government body responsible for budget forecasting and execution by the fifth day of the month following the reporting month. The reports use the form approved by that body.
computation_methods: The indicator is calculated as the sum of actual project expenditure.
disaggregation: Data are disaggregated by two types of financial flow.
